answer: Tie each agent profile to one active electricity meter. The utility confirms the holder and six months of service, then seals the meter number on the ledger, one profile per meter. A transfer or second claim freezes the profile for 30 days, and a monthly recheck suspends dead or duplicate meters and burns a $120 deposit. Faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 real meters, $120,000 in deposits and $85,000 a month in bills. Like a river running through one channel per home, checked against an atlas of real addresses, a sybil flood dries up when each drop comes from an ivory-tagged meter.
